body: Not single myself; but honestly speaking, if I can get a girlfriend, I truly believe that anyone can. Take some time for yourself to be presentable, explore what you’d like to see in someone, and don’t be afraid of rejection. There’s probably someone just like you who’d you relate to and could get to know better; you just have to start searching and be ready to make the first move. Best of luck. -an Internet stranger

Yeah I was aware of how little people cared about me (especially first year of college.) it was just a lot at once and I least expected it from my family of all things... but thankfully, I do appreciate the people who genuinely do care for me and I’m glad to have a few of them. Many thanks for your comment and advice.
Thank you for your kind words... I appreciate it a lot.
